verses.en: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.sm: Levi. O le aiga o Saulo Sa tusia gafa o Isaraelu uma. Faauta foi, ua tusia i latou i le tusi i tupu o Isaraelu. Na tafea foi Iuta i Papelonia ona o a latou agasala.

verses.en: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
verses.sm: O e na muai nonofo i o latou fanua i a latou aai, o Isaraelu, o le au faitaulaga, o sa Levi, ma le au netini.

verses.en: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.sm: Ua nonofo foi i lerusalema nisi o le fanauga a luta, ma nisi o le fanauga a Peniamina, ma nisi o le fanauga a Efaraima ma Manase.

verses.en: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.sm: O Utai le atalii o Ameuta, o le atalii o Omeri, le atalii o Imeri, o le atalii o Pani, na tupu mai i atalii o Faresa le atalii o Iuta.

verses.en: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.sm: Na tupu mai ia Seloni; o Asaia le ulumatua, ma ona atalii;

verses.en: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.sm: mai atalii o Sera; o Ieielu, ma o latou uso e ono selau ma Je iva sefulu;

verses.en: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.sm: mai atalii o Peniamina; o Salu le atalii o Mesulama, o le atalii o Hotavia, o le atalii o Hasenua,

verses.en: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.sm: o Ipeneia foi le atalii o Ieroama, ma Ele le atalii o Usi, o le atalii o Mekeri, ma Mesulama le atalii o Sefatia, o le atalii ia o Reuelu, o le atalii ia o Ipenia.

verses.en: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.sm: O latou uso foi, i o latou tupulaga, e iva selau ma le lima sefulu ma le ono. O tagata uma ia O matai sili i le aiga o latou tama.

verses.en: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.sm: Na tupu mai i le au faitaulaga; o Ietaia, ma loaripa, ma lakinu,

verses.en: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.sm: tt o Asaria foi o le atalii o Hilikia, o le atalii ia o Mesulama, o le atalii ia o Satoka, o le atalii ia o Meraiota, o le atalii ia o Akitopo, o le pwe i le fale o le Atua;

verses.en: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.sm: o Ataia foi o le atalii o Ieroama, o le atalii ia o Pasura, o le atalii ia o Malekia, o Maseai le atalii o Atielu, o le atalii ia o Iaesera, o le atalii ia o Mesulama, o le atalii ia 0 Meselemita, o le atalii ia o Imeru.

verses.en: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.sm: O latou uso foi, o matai sili i aiga o latou tama, e tasi le afe ma le fitu selau ma le toaono sefulu; o tagata malolosi lava i auauna i le galuega o le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.sm: Na tupu mai foi i sa Levi; o Semaia o le atalii o Hasupo, o le atalii ia o Aserikama, o le atalii ia o Hasapea, mai le fanauga a Merari;

verses.en: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.sm: o Pakepakara foi, o Heresa, ma Kalali, ma Matania o le atalii o Mika, o le atalii ia o Sekari, o le atalii ia o Asafo;

verses.en: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.sm: o Opetaia foi le atalii o Semaia, o le atalii ia o Kalali, o le atalii ia o Iutana, ma Perekia le atalii o Asa, O le atalii ia o Elekana, o e na nonofo i aai o tagata Netopa.

verses.en: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
verses.sm: O leoleo faitotoa nei, o Saluma, ma Akopa, ma Talemoni, ma Aimano, ma o latou uso; o Saluma o le matai sili ia;

verses.en: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.sm: na leoleo i le faitotoa .o le tupu i le itu i sasae, ua oo mai i nei ona po; o leoleo faitotoa ia i vasega o le fanauga a Levi.

verses.en: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.
verses.sm: O Saluma foi le atalii o Kori, O le atalii ia o Eviasafo, o le atalii ia o Koru, ma ona uso, o le aiga o lona tamá, O sa Korú, na pule i le faiga o le galuega, o leoleo o faitotoa o le fale fetafai; o latou tama foi na pule i toagálauapi a le ALII, o e na leoleo i le mea e ui atu ai.

verses.en: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
verses.sm: O Fineaso foi le atalii o Eleasaro, na pule o ia ia te i latou anamua, sa ia te ia le ALII.

verses.en: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: O Sakaria le atalii o Meselemia na leoleo i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.sm: O i latou uma ia sa filifilia e fai ma leoleo i faitotoa, e toalua selau ma le toasefulu ma le toalua. Sa tusia o latou gafa i a latou aai, o i latou na tofia e Tavita ma Samuelu le tapata vaai, io latou tofiga.

verses.en: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.sm: O i latou ma a latou fanau sa leoleo faitotoa o le fale o le ALII, o le fale fetafai foi, e tusa ma a latou leoleoga.

verses.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.sm: Sa i ai leoleo faitotoa i itu e fa, o sasae, ma sisifo, ma le itu i matu, ma le itu i toga.

verses.en: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.sm: O latou uso foi, e na nonofo i o latou aai, e o mai E feaua‘i ma i latou, taifitu o latou aso.

verses.en: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.sm: Ana o tagata ia o sa Levi, o leoleo sili i faitotoa, sa i ai i latou e toafa i o latou tofiga, sa leoleo foi i potu ma mea e teu ai oa o i le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
verses.sm: Ua latou nonofo faataaliolio foi i le fale o le Atua, aua sa ia te i latou e leoleo ai, e a latou foi e tatala faitotoa i taeao uma lava.

verses.en: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.sm: O isi o i latou na tausi ai ipu e fai a‘i sauniga, ina ia faitau ai pe a avane i totonu, ma faitau ai pe a toe au mai i fafo.

verses.en: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.sm: O isi foi o i latou ua tofia e tausi ai ipu, ma mea paia uma, ma le falaoa lelei, ma le uaina, ma le suauu, ma le pulu lipano, ma mea manogi.

verses.en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.sm: O isi foi atalii o le au faitaulaga na faia e i latou le uu manogi.

verses.en: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.sm: O Matatia o lo sa Levi, o le ulumatua ia a Saluma, o lo sa Korӣ, e ana le tofiga e pwe i le faiga o mea e tunu i uamea salalafa.

verses.en: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.sm: O isi foi o latou uso, o lo sa Koató, sa ia te i latou le areto e laulauina i luma e sauniuni ai i lea sapati ma lea sapati.

verses.en: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.sm: O i latou ia e pepese, o matai sili o sa Levi, sa nonofo i potu, sa aunoa ma isi galuega; auā na latou i ai i lea faiva i le ao atoa ma le po.

verses.en: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.sm: O matai sili ia o sa Levi, ua sili i o latou tupulaga; ua nonofo i latou i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
verses.sm: Ua mau i Kipeona o Ieielu le tamā o Kipeona, o le igoa o lana avā o Maaka.

verses.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.sm: O lona atalii ulumatua o Avatonu, ma Suro, ma Kiso, ma Paala, ma Neru, ma Natapu,

verses.en: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.sm: o Kitoru foi, ma Aio, ma Sakaria, ma Mekelota.

verses.en: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Mekelota o Semaama. Ua latou mau foi ma o latou uso i Ierusalema, ua faafeagai ma o latou uso.

verses.en: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Neru o Kiso, ua fanaua e Kiso o Saulo, ua fanaua foi e Saulo o Ionatana, ma Makisua, ma Apinatapa, ma Esepaala.

verses.en: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Ionatana o Meripaala, na fanaua c Meripaala, o Mika.

verses.en: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.sm: O atalii o Mika; o Pitonu, ma Meleka, ma Tarea.

verses.en: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.sm: Ua fanaua e Aasa o lara; o lara foi ua fanaua e ia o Alemetu, ma Asemau, ma Semeri; ua fanaua e Semeri o Mosa.

verses.en: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.sm: Ua fanaua foi e Mosa o Pinea; o Refaia foi lona atalii, o Eliasa lona atalii, o Aselu lona atalii.

verses.en: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.sm: O atalii o Aselu e toaono, o latou igoa foi nei; o Aserikama, o Pokeru, ma Isamaeli, ma Searia, ma Opetaia, ma Hanana. O atalii ia o
